title: Imagine That
description: Membicarakan situasi imajiner, memberi saran, dan mengungkapkan keinginan tentang masa sekarang. Kamu akan belajar second conditional, If I were you, I wish + past simple, serta perbedaan first conditional (real) dan second conditional (imaginary).
objectives: Membentuk dan memakai second conditional untuk situasi imajiner di masa sekarang atau masa depan
Memberi saran dengan If I were you, I'd ...
Mengungkapkan keinginan tentang situasi sekarang dengan I wish + past simple / were / could
Memilih first atau second conditional sesuai seberapa nyata situasinya, termasuk saat membicarakan uang dan impian

lessons.title: The Second Conditional
lessons.summary: Membicarakan situasi imajiner atau kecil kemungkinannya dengan If + past simple, would/could/might + V1.
objectives: Membentuk second conditional dengan if + past simple dan would/could/might + V1
Memahami bahwa past simple di if-clause tidak berarti masa lalu
Membuat pertanyaan What would you do if ...?
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Apa itu second conditional?
Second conditional dipakai untuk membicarakan situasi **imajiner** atau situasi yang **kecil kemungkinannya** terjadi, di masa sekarang atau masa depan. We use it to imagine a different present: *If I had wings, I would fly to school.* (Saya tidak punya sayap — ini hanya imajinasi.)

Bandingkan dengan first conditional dari Unit 4: *If it rains, I'll stay at home* (mungkin benar-benar terjadi). The second conditional is about things that are not true now or will probably not happen.

### Form
| If-clause | Main clause |
|---|---|
| If + subject + **past simple** | subject + **would / could / might** + V1 |
| If I **had** more time, | I **would learn** Japanese. |
| If we **lived** near the sea, | we **could go** swimming every day. |
| If he **studied** harder, | he **might pass** the test. |

Penting: walaupun kita memakai **past simple**, artinya **bukan masa lalu**. The past form shows *distance from reality* (jarak dari kenyataan). *If I had a car* = sekarang saya tidak punya mobil.

### would, could, might
- **would** = hasil yang pasti di dunia imajinasi: *I would buy a house.*
- **could** = would be able to (bisa): *If I had a car, I could drive you home.*
- **might** = mungkin, tidak pasti: *If I lived in Port Selwyn, I might open a café.*

Kontraksi: I would → **I'd**, she would → **she'd**, would not → **wouldn't**.

### Urutan klausa
The if-clause can come first or second. Jika *if* berada di depan, pakai koma: *If I won the prize, I'd be very happy.* Jika *if* di tengah, biasanya tanpa koma: *I'd be very happy if I won the prize.* The meaning is the same.

### Questions
To ask about imaginary situations, put **would** before the subject: *What would you do if you found a lot of money?* — *If I found a lot of money, I'd take it to the police.* Pertanyaan ini sangat umum dalam percakapan dan ujian speaking.

### Kesalahan umum
- Jangan pakai **would** di if-clause: ~~If I would have money~~ → *If I had money*.
- Jangan pakai **will** di main clause: ~~If I had money, I will travel~~ → *I would travel*.
- Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita cukup bilang "kalau" atau "seandainya" tanpa mengubah kata kerja. In English, the verb form must change.

lessons.title: If I Were You: Giving Advice
lessons.summary: Memakai were untuk semua subject dalam second conditional dan memberi saran dengan If I were you, I'd ...
objectives: Memakai were untuk semua subject dalam second conditional
Memberi saran positif dan negatif dengan If I were you, I'd / I wouldn't ...
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Were untuk semua subject
Dalam second conditional, kita memakai **were** untuk semua subject, termasuk *I, he, she, it*: *If I were rich...*, *If she were here...*. This is the standard form in writing and formal English. Dalam percakapan santai, penutur asli juga sering berkata *If I was...*, tetapi dalam pelajaran ini kita berlatih bentuk **were** karena selalu benar dan selalu diterima dalam ujian.

| Subject | Second conditional | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| I | If I were ... | If I were taller, I'd play basketball. |
| he / she / it | If he were ... | If it were cheaper, we'd buy it. |
| you / we / they | If you were ... | If they were here, they'd help us. |

### If I were you = memberi saran
The phrase **If I were you, I'd (= I would) + V1** is a very common way to give advice. Artinya "Kalau aku jadi kamu, aku akan ...". It sounds friendly and personal, karena pembicara membayangkan dirinya berada di posisi pendengar.
- *If I were you, I'd talk to the manager.*
- *If I were you, I wouldn't buy that phone.* (saran negatif)
- *I'd take an umbrella if I were you.* (if-clause di belakang)

### Bandingkan dengan should
You already know **should** from A2: *You should see a doctor.* Both are fine for advice, but *If I were you* sounds a little softer.

| Lebih langsung | Lebih lembut/personal |
|---|---|
| You should rest. | If I were you, I'd rest. |
| You shouldn't eat so late. | If I were you, I wouldn't eat so late. |

### Menanggapi saran
Useful responses: *That's a good idea.* / *You're right. I'll do that.* / *Thanks, but I don't think I can.* Perhatikan bahwa jawaban tentang rencana nyata kembali memakai **will** (*I'll do that*), karena keputusan itu nyata.

### Hati-hati
- Jangan pakai ~~If I am you~~ — kamu tidak mungkin menjadi orang lain, jadi situasinya selalu imajiner → **were**.
- Main clause memakai **would/'d + V1**, bukan *will*: ~~If I were you, I will ...~~
- Jangan tambahkan *to*: ~~I'd to call her~~ → *I'd call her*.
- Gunakan koma setelah *If I were you* jika frasa itu di awal kalimat.

lessons.title: I Wish: Wishes About the Present
lessons.summary: Mengungkapkan keinginan tentang situasi sekarang yang tidak nyata dengan I wish + past simple / were / could.
objectives: Membentuk kalimat I wish + past simple untuk keinginan tentang masa sekarang
Memakai were dan could setelah wish
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Mengungkapkan keinginan tentang sekarang
Kita memakai **I wish + past simple** untuk mengatakan bahwa kita ingin situasi **sekarang** berbeda. The situation is not true now, so we use a past form — sama seperti di second conditional.
- *I wish I had a car.* (Saya tidak punya mobil. Seandainya punya.)
- *I wish I lived near my office.* (Kenyataannya saya tinggal jauh.)
- *I wish I were taller.* (Saya tidak tinggi.)

### Form
| Kenyataan (reality) | Wish |
|---|---|
| I don't have a garden. | I wish I **had** a garden. |
| My flat is small. | I wish my flat **were** bigger. |
| I can't swim. | I wish I **could** swim. |
| She lives far away. | I wish she **lived** nearer. |
| I have to work today. | I wish I **didn't have to** work today. |

Perhatikan polanya: positive ↔ negative. If the reality is negative, the wish is positive, and if the reality is positive, the wish is negative.

### were dan could
- Seperti di second conditional, **were** bisa dipakai untuk semua subject: *I wish he were here.* (In informal English, people also say *I wish he was here*.)
- **can → could**: *I can't drive* → *I wish I could drive.*

### wish vs hope
**Hope** is for things that are possible or still unknown: *I hope you pass the exam.* (mungkin terjadi). **Wish** is for things that are unreal now: *I wish I were ten years younger.* Jangan katakan ~~I wish you pass the exam~~.

| hope | wish |
|---|---|
| real possibility | unreal / impossible now |
| I hope it's sunny tomorrow. | I wish it were sunny today. (it's raining) |

### Subject lain
*She wishes she knew the answer.* *My parents wish they had more free time.* Ingat: **wish** sendiri tetap mengikuti present simple (*she wishes*, dengan -es), tetapi kata kerja setelahnya memakai bentuk past.

### Padanan bahasa Indonesia
"Seandainya ..." atau "Andai saja ..." sering menjadi padanan *I wish*. Example: *Andai saja aku bisa bahasa Jepang* = *I wish I could speak Japanese.* In this lesson we only use wish for the **present**; wishes about the past use a different structure that you will learn later.

lessons.title: First or Second Conditional?
lessons.summary: Membedakan situasi nyata (first conditional) dan situasi imajiner (second conditional).
objectives: Membedakan first conditional (real) dan second conditional (imaginary)
Memilih conditional berdasarkan konteks dan pendapat pembicara
Menghindari pencampuran bentuk will/would yang salah
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Real or imaginary?
Kamu sekarang sudah tahu dua conditional dengan *if* untuk masa sekarang dan masa depan. The difference is not about time — keduanya bisa membicarakan masa depan. The difference is **how real or likely** the situation is.

| | First conditional | Second conditional |
|---|---|---|
| Form | If + present simple, will + V1 | If + past simple, would + V1 |
| Meaning | real, possible (mungkin terjadi) | imaginary, unlikely (khayalan / kecil kemungkinan) |
| Example | If I see Rina, I'll tell her. | If I saw a lion in the street, I'd run. |

### Situasi yang sama, makna berbeda
The speaker chooses the conditional based on what he or she believes.
- *If I get the job, I'll move to Port Selwyn.* → Saya sudah melamar dan peluangnya nyata.
- *If I got the job, I'd move to Port Selwyn.* → Saya merasa peluangnya kecil, atau saya hanya berandai-andai.

Both sentences are grammatically correct, so the **context** tells you which one is better.

### Petunjuk dari konteks
| Konteks | Pilih |
|---|---|
| Plans and likely events (*I have an interview tomorrow*) | First |
| Facts that are not true now (*I don't have a car*) | Second |
| Impossible things (*If I were a cat ...*) | Second |
| Dreams with a very small chance (*win the lottery*) | Usually second |

### Jangan mencampur bentuk
Pasangannya harus konsisten: **present + will** atau **past + would**.
- ~~If it rains, I would stay at home.~~ → *If it rains, I'll stay at home.*
- ~~If I had time, I will help you.~~ → *If I had time, I'd help you.*

### Pertanyaan
- *What will you do if it rains on Saturday?* (a real plan — hujan benar-benar mungkin)
- *What would you do if you were the president?* (imaginary — hanya berandai-andai)

### Tips
Ask yourself: "Is this true or possible in real life?" Jika jawabannya *ya, mungkin terjadi* → first conditional. Jika jawabannya *tidak, ini bukan kenyataan* atau *hampir tidak mungkin* → second conditional. Look for clues in the sentence before or after the conditional, for example *I don't have...*, *I've applied for...*, or *It's impossible, but...*.

sections.explanation:
### Talking about money
Topik uang sangat cocok untuk berlatih second conditional, karena kita sering berandai-andai: *If I had more money...* Here are the key verbs.

| Verb | Arti | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| earn | mendapat (gaji/penghasilan) | She earns a good salary. |
| save (up) | menabung | I'm saving up for a laptop. |
| spend | membelanjakan; menghabiskan | He spends too much on clothes. |
| afford | mampu membayar | We can't afford a new car. |
| borrow | meminjam (dari) | Can I borrow some money from you? |
| lend | meminjamkan (kepada) | Could you lend me some money? |
| owe | berutang | I owe my brother 100,000 rupiah. |

### borrow vs lend
Ini kesalahan klasik bagi pelajar Indonesia karena keduanya sering diterjemahkan "pinjam". **Borrow** = you *take* something for a short time: *I borrowed a book from Maya.* **Lend** = you *give* something for a short time: *Maya lent me a book.* (lend – lent – lent). Ingat polanya: *borrow something FROM someone*; *lend someone something* atau *lend something TO someone*.

### afford
**Afford** is usually used with *can / can't / could*: *I can't afford a holiday this year. If I earned more, I could afford a bigger flat.* Setelah afford bisa ada noun atau to-infinitive: *We can't afford to eat out every day.*

### Dreams and hypothetical situations
Useful expressions:
- *win the lottery* – menang lotre
- *become a millionaire* – menjadi jutawan
- *give money to charity* – menyumbang ke badan amal
- *make a budget* – membuat anggaran
- *pay back* – membayar kembali (utang)

*If I won the lottery, I'd pay back the money I owe and give some to charity.*
*If I made a budget, I wouldn't spend so much on snacks.*

### Wishes about money
Gabungkan dengan *I wish* dari pelajaran sebelumnya: *I wish I earned more.* *I wish I didn't owe so much money.* *I wish I could afford a new phone.*

### Strategi bicara
When someone asks *What would you do if you were rich?*, answer with two or three ideas and connect them: *First, I'd ... Then I'd ... But I wouldn't ... because ...* Ini membuat jawabanmu lebih panjang, runtut, dan terdengar alami. Remember to keep the form consistent: past simple in the if-clause, would in the main clause.
